title: Bar Series Forest Fruits 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Forest Fruits by Bar Series blends a medley of ripe, juicy berries into a sweet and vibrant vape. The flavour opens with dark, jammy blackberry and sharp raspberry notes, brightened by a twist of blueberry for added richness and depth. This fruit mix delivers a full-flavoured vape that's both bold and balanced, with enough complexity to stay fresh and appealing every day. Formulated with nicotine salts, this e-liquid delivers a smooth, yet tactile throat hit and rapid nicotine uptake. It's blended at a 50VG/50PG ratio, making it ideal for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping with refillable pod kits and vape starter kits . Explore Bar Series' wide range of flavours, which includes fruit blends, confectionery, icy menthols and many more exciting profiles crafted with extra-concentrated flavour for intense taste. Bar Series e-liquids cater to all vapers by offering 5mg, 10mg and 20mg nic salts designed to perform perfectly in your favourite pod kit.
